paraphrase: At spreading centers, mantle magma makes new crust.
synthesis: Spreading created new crust and enlarged the Atlantic; spreading also formed the Red Sea.
abstraction: Spreading is a common process underlying Atlantic enlargement and Red Sea formation.
negatives: All ocean basins formed by the same spreading process.
The named examples do not license a claim about every ocean basin.
A new spreading center is developing under Africa along the East African Rift Zone.
The evidence says may, not is.
The Mid-Atlantic Ridge spreads at about 2.5 meters per year.
The source gives centimeters per year, not meters.
invalid relation projection due to changed scope
Spreading processes create all oceans and all continental fractures.
A common process label does not widen the endpoints to all oceans and fractures.
uncertain: The spreading center under Africa will become an ocean in ten million years.

paraphrase: Jet streams arise where warm air meets cold air in the atmosphere.
synthesis: When warm and cool air meet, warm air rises and cool air sinks to replace it.
abstraction: Opposing vertical movements of warm and cool air participate in creating an air current.
negatives: Every meeting of warm and cold air produces an equally powerful jet stream.
The evidence supplies neither every-meeting scope nor equal power.
An airplane gets a jet-stream boost regardless of its travel direction.
The boost is conditional on traveling in the same direction.
The cooler air rises while the warmer air sinks to replace it.
The warm and cool referents have been exchanged.
Jet streams average about 110 kilometers per hour.
The source specifies miles per hour.
uncertain: The next jet stream over this location will move at 110 miles per hour.

paraphrase: Introduced bills are usually referred to the chamber's committees with relevant jurisdiction.
synthesis: Committee review may include hearings, and markup includes votes on proposed amendments before reporting with adopted changes.
abstraction: Committee review can gather views and revise proposed legislation before reporting it to the chamber.
negatives: Committee review guarantees that each reported bill has bipartisan support.
Every introduced bill is referred to exactly one committee.
Typically and committee or committees have both been lost.
A committee chair selects formal attention over a four-year Congress.
The frozen source specifies a two-year Congress.
A committee reports a bill before considering any amendments at markup.
The frozen account describes reporting with changes adopted in markup, not this inverted order.
uncertain: The next introduced bill will be reported by its committee.

paraphrase: Among worlds known to us, Earth alone is known to host life.
synthesis: The solar system formed from gas and dust; such clouds contain ingredients for stars and planets.
abstraction: Orbital dependence helps distinguish the source's categories: moons require a planet to orbit, and planets require a star to orbit.
negatives: Every nebula forms a solar system identical to ours.
Ingredients for formation do not guarantee identical outcomes.
A nearby star's explosion definitely triggered formation of our solar system.
The source says currently think and perhaps.
For something to be a moon it needs to orbit a star rather than a planet.
The defining orbit target is a planet.
Earth is not a world known to have life.
Directly negates the frozen known-life assertion; the entity itself is not substituted.
uncertain: There is no life anywhere outside Earth.

paraphrase: Biological, physical and chemical processes sustain ecological systems.
synthesis: Ecological processes sustain systems and provide resources and air/water-quality regulation, yet direct national-scale measurement is difficult.
abstraction: Scale is a measurement boundary: watershed process indicators exist, but their national-scale development remains a research challenge.
negatives: Remote sensing directly measures every ecological process at national scale.
Snapshots and inference do not establish universal direct measurement.
Repeated measures over a season always provide an indicator of net primary production.
Respiration, nutrient cycling and decomposition indicators have been developed at the national scale.
The evidence explicitly denies national-scale development.
invalid relation projection due to changed scope
All ecological services can be directly measured by the existing watershed indicators.
Indicators for selected processes do not project to every service or direct measurement.
uncertain: A national decomposition indicator will be available next year.

paraphrase: Atomic structural order and defects were associated with magnetic properties at the level of individual atoms.
synthesis: Scientists mapped more than 23,000 atomic positions with 22 picometer precision and correlated structural order and defects with magnetic properties.
abstraction: Linking atomic arrangements to properties supplies a basis for designing materials with desired properties.
negatives: The atomic arrangement alone completely determines every material property.
Correlations and design relevance do not prove complete determination.
The observed atomic defects caused the measured magnetic properties.
The frozen research account reports correlation, not this causal finding.
The atomic positions were measured with 22 nanometer precision.
Scientists mapped 16,627 iron atoms and 6,569 platinum atoms.
The two element counts are exchanged.
uncertain: The measured defects are the sole cause of magnetic behavior in every nanoparticle.

paraphrase: A roadway need not become narrower for a bottleneck to occur.
synthesis: FHWA attributes 40 percent of nationwide congestion to bottlenecks and another 5 percent to poor signal timing; together these are said to account for 45 percent.
abstraction: Recurring bottleneck delay is a joint-condition phenomenon: design deficiency and traffic overburden are both required in the source's account.
negatives: Every delay anywhere on a corridor is caused by a bottleneck at one location.
Local bottleneck scope cannot be widened to all delay.
At a recurring bottleneck, deficient design alone suffices for delay regardless of demand.
The source expressly requires both deficiency and overburden.
FHWA attributes 45 percent of congestion to bottlenecks alone.
45 percent is the combined figure, not the bottleneck-only figure.
invalid relation projection due to changed scope
All road design causes pervasive corridor congestion even without traffic overburden.
The endpoint and conditional scope of the physical bottleneck relation have changed.
uncertain: Removing this bottleneck will reduce next year's nationwide congestion by exactly 40 percent.

paraphrase: Measurement uncertainty reflects incomplete knowledge of the quantity being measured.
synthesis: Uncertainty expresses incomplete knowledge of a measurand, and a distribution over its possible values represents that knowledge state.
abstraction: Measurement uncertainty is a way to characterize limited knowledge, not a claim that a single reported value is certainly exact.
negatives: Any uncertainty interval guarantees that the true value is its midpoint.
No midpoint guarantee follows from interval or distribution language.
For every measurand, uncertainty must be a standard deviation.
The source's scalar example admits alternatives; it is not a universal must.
The International Prototype Kilogram has mass 1 gram.
Calibration makes instrument indications meaningful only if uncertainty is zero.
The zero-uncertainty dependency is absent from the frozen calibration condition.
uncertain: This unreported instrument has uncertainty exactly 0.01 kg.
